meta.title: Qafila Robotics — One fleet. Every robot.
meta.description: Qafila Fleet is one platform to see, control and coordinate a mixed fleet of robots — humanoids, quadrupeds, drones and ground vehicles — from one screen. Built in Qatar, for the Gulf.

hero.headline: One fleet. Every robot.
hero.subhead: See, control and coordinate every robot from one screen — humanoids, quadrupeds, drones and ground vehicles, led as a single caravan.
hero.convoyAlt: The Qafila fleet walking as a convoy on a dune: a ground car, a drone, a quadruped and a humanoid leader.

problem.title: Many robots, no single view
problem.intro: Organisations buy robots from different makers. Each arrives with its own app, its own login and its own map.
problem.point1Body: Every robot type needs its own tool, so operators switch screens to do one job.
problem.point2Body: Nobody sees where every robot is, what it is doing, or whether it is still connected.
problem.point3Body: Robots cannot hand work to each other, and what one robot learns stays with that robot.

howItWorks.title: How Qafila works
howItWorks.step1Body: Bring any robot onto the fleet — any maker, any network.
howItWorks.step2Body: Live video, status and position for every robot on one map.
howItWorks.step3Body: Run missions across robot types from a single screen.
howItWorks.step4Body: What one robot finds, the whole fleet knows.

fleet.title: The fleet
fleet.intro: Four robot types, led as one caravan. Photos of the real fleet are added as they become available.
fleet.vendorLine: Qafila works with robots from any maker. Our current fleet:
fleet.humanoidBody: Our Unitree G1 humanoid works where people work — stairs, doors and tools made for human hands.
fleet.quadrupedBody: Unitree Go2 quadrupeds cross rough ground and tight spaces that wheels cannot.
fleet.droneBody: In-house Raspberry Pi drones see from above — roofs, towers and wide sites — then land and report.
fleet.groundBody: In-house Raspberry Pi ground cars carry sensors along routes they measure and map.

useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.intro: What the fleet does, and what the operator sees from one screen.
useCases.inspectionTask: Read gauges, scan equipment and log faults on a schedule.
useCases.securityTask: Patrol routes, check doors and flag anything out of place.
useCases.eventsTask: Greet, guide and answer questions in busy public spaces.
useCases.researchTask: A shared platform for universities to test robots and missions.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.intro: We describe how the robots stop. We do not promise zero risk.
safety.point1: When the link drops, the robot stops.
safety.point2: Every command expires, so a lost message can never keep a robot moving.
safety.point3: A new mission needs an operator's approval before it runs.
safety.point4: Every action is logged, so you can see what happened and when.

status.title: Where we are
status.intro: Honest about the stage we are at: the platform is in active development. No phase is marked complete until it is demonstrated on the real fleet or in simulation — not when the code merely compiles.
status.pilotLine: A pilot programme is opening. [TBD] current fleet details.

about.title: Built in Qatar, for the Gulf
about.body: Qafila Robotics builds one platform that leads a mixed fleet of robots as a single caravan. We are based in Qatar and build in Arabic and English from the start.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains how Qafila Robotics handles the information you send through this site.
privacy.whatBody: When you send a pilot request we receive the name, organisation, email, optional phone, chosen use case and message you provide.
privacy.whyBody: We use it only to reply to your request and arrange a meeting. We do not sell it and do not use tracking cookies on this site.
